rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a marked measuring ruler.

example.english: This ruler is thirty centimetres long.
example.traditional: 呢把間尺有三十厘米長。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 gaan3 cek3 jau5 saam1 sap6 lei4 mai5 zoeng2

rows.note: Use this shortened form when the context already makes clear that the object is a ruler.

example.english: Bring me the ruler; I need to draw a straight line.
example.traditional: 你拎把尺過嚟，我要畫直線。
example.jyutping: nei5 ling1 baa2 cek3 gwo3 lai4 ngo5 jiu3 waa6 zik6 sin3

rows.note: Use this when specifically distinguishing a straightedge or straight ruler from other kinds of measuring tools.

example.english: For technical drawings, I always use a straight ruler.
example.traditional: 做工程圖，我一定用直尺。
example.jyutping: zou6 gung1 cing4 tou4 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jung6 zik6 cek3

rows.note: Use this for a person or ruling power that governs others, rather than for a measuring device.

example.english: That ruler governed people through force.
example.traditional: 嗰位統治者靠武力管治人民。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 tung2 zi6 ze2 kaau3 mou5 lik6 gun2 zi6 jan4 man4
